name: MD-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Elfreth with large fundraising edge
model.rationale: The D+12 district, Elfreth's incumbency, and a roughly 90-to-1 fundraising advantage over Berney Flowers all point to a comfortable Democratic hold, and prediction markets price her near 95%. With no polls or expert ratings available, uncertainty stays elevated but the fundamentals leave little doubt.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending showing unexpected Republican traction would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Sarah Elfreth, a Democratic incumbent, is favored to hold Maryland's 3rd District against Republican Berney Flowers. The district leans Democratic by about 12 points on the partisan vote index, and the fundamentals point to a margin in the low twenties. Elfreth has raised over $1.1 million and holds more than $330,000 on hand, while Flowers has raised roughly $13,000 with minimal cash remaining. No outside groups are active in the race, and no general-election polls or expert ratings are available.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at about 95 percent. With no polling to lean on, uncertainty is somewhat wider than usual, but the combination of district lean, incumbency, and overwhelming financial advantage makes an upset unlikely.
